stem:
Read these sentences from paragraph 18.

Smooth, sticky soil has lots of clay. When this soil dries out, it becomes as hard as concrete.

What is the best paraphrase of these sentences?

options.label: A
options.text: Clay is a type of soil that keeps plants from growing.

options.label: B
options.text: Clay dries out quickly and becomes concrete.

options.label: C
options.text: Sticky soil has clay in it and becomes hard when it is dry.

options.label: D
options.text: Sticky soil has different types of clay in it.

visual_elements: Smooth, sticky soil has lots of clay. When this soil dries out, it becomes as hard as concrete.
